    Partner interoperability capabilities

    Source: R/interop-capabilities.R
    at_interop_capabilities.Rd

    Report what this hyperannotatR installation can exchange with a partner package such as qupflowR, and how far each capability has been qualified. Profiles follow the partner contract: I0 file interchange, I1 public R API, I2 the local control service (annotatr-control-v1) and I3 the embeddable app object from at_app(). A profile is "supported" only with implementation, runtime dependencies and qualification evidence; implemented profiles that have not passed their tests against a real partner client are "planned"; profiles whose optional runtime is missing are "unavailable". Every entry carries a reason when it is not supported.

    Usage

    at_interop_capabilities(
  target = c("package", "hsi", "app", "control"),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

    Arguments

    target

    One or more of "package", "hsi", "app", "control".

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    A list of class at_capabilities with schema, schema_version, annotatr_version, r_version, source_revision, consumer, profiles (I0-I3), limits, and the requested sections package, hsi, app, control, plus digest: the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the report without digest itself.

    See also

    at_interop_manifest(), at_control_capabilities()

    Other interop: at_annotation_revision(), at_commit_qupflowr(), at_export_qupflowr(), at_import_qupflowr(), at_interop_manifest(), at_stage_qupflowr()

    Examples

    caps <- at_interop_capabilities()
caps$profiles$I0$status
#> [1] "supported"
caps$digest
#> [1] "d635a2101a97788c784d52220c1c4e3ff211965d1cb7d93c85d0953b274f9410"
